cues: Populations do not grow by a fixed number each year, which would be a straight line.
They grow by a fixed proportion, so the increase itself keeps getting bigger: exponential growth, a J curve.
Set P t equal to twice P nought, and the doubling time comes out as the natural log of two over r.
With r as a percentage, that is about seventy divided by the rate: the rule of seventy.
